title: Really adding more visual polish and game juice to my cozy life blooming game.
author: 74BIT
selftext:
Next Fest has come and gone. I got some wishlists and you know what, its enough for me to finish the game. Mostly I just want to finish for my own sake since I think vacuuming dead matter and blooming life is a fun cozy mechanic. Also just want to polish it a bit more.

I plan on having the game done in a month (fingers crossed)

By then my game will have:  

* Story about Yorick and Ophelia. He is remembering who she is and what she means to him. 
* 2 more planets - unique themes, marvels and discoveries
* simple cinematics to tell the story
* Playtime should be maybe 2 hours (est.)

The demo is out and you can try now. Give it a play and send me a message to let me know what you think!

[Yorick Worlds in Bloom](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5067090/Yorick_Worlds_in_Bloom/)
